ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels dominate approximately 75-80% of the visible surface, with low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated at the perimeter, notch, and peduncle attachment point.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the center of both lobes. Black pigmentation forms a continuous border along the trailing edge and tips. Dense black linear mottling is visible on the inner left lobe. Tan/yellowish patches are distributed across the medial white areas.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a sharp convergence point; estimated angle between 50-60 degrees with a depth extending approx. 15% into the fluke vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire horizontal boundary; right lobe trailing edge displays higher-amplitude jagged peaks compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edge from notch to mid-lobe, transitioning to convex curvature at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity, circular white spots (barnacle attachment sites) are concentrated on the far-left and far-right distal tips within the black pigmented zones.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of at least 5-7 distinct, vertically-oriented black linear streaks (rake marks) traverse the high-intensity white region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Healed rake marks on the left lobe; multiple irregular V-shaped chips and indentations along the trailing edge margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-brown staining across the primary white surfaces, likely representing diatom accumulation or localized pigmentation variance.
